messages:
ryan: Quick postmortem follow-up: assign owners for runbook edits, short timelines, and a playback for next oncall. Keep items small.

pm_renee: please list owners + ETA so I can mark followups.

ryan: proposed:
- DB triage commands + thresholds -> maya (3 business days)
- Pager pre-checks + 5min playback -> oliver (2 business days)
- Scheduler throttle validation -> maya (1 week)

maya: I'll add explicit SQL + kubectl snippets and thresholds. Example: `psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() as lag;"` Thresholds: >=20s mitigation, >=60s escalate. PR ETA 3d.

oliver: Pager edits: add 5min DM pre-escalation and a playback checklist (5-10m) to run the quick checks and log dump. PR ETA 48h.

sre_bot: Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026/pg-kv-timeout-1763449000

ryan: maya please also validate job-scheduler thresholds while you look at patterns (we've seen 3 partial timeouts in ~10w tied to big jobs).

maya: will validate and propose a safe default (e.g., pause big jobs if DB QPS > 1600 for 5m). Findings ETA 7d.

oliver: owners open GH issues and drop numbers here so pm_renee can track. cadence: update this thread every 3 business days until PRs merged.

pm_renee: noted. thanks, keep PRs focused and link back to the postmortem.

ryan: creating issue pointers now, will add links when done.
